title: MetadataProvider's by-name object scope records a failed read as "missing", so useObjectPresence reads a transient error as "absent"
body:
Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`) from objectui#12980 part 6 (PR #13005). Sources: the dev report `6257144439` (out-of-scope finding 1) and the contract review `6257229878`, which judged it file-worthy, class b. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and routing are triage's.

## What (objectui `origin/main`)
- `packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx`: `getItem` (about :856) catches every error and returns `null`. `fetchScopeName` (about :955) records a `null` answer as `missing`.
- So a by-name object read that FAILS (a transient 5xx, a network drop) is recorded exactly as one the server answered "not found".
- `useObjectPresence`'s module contract says an error reads `unknown`, and that absence must be earned. Through the object scope, a failed read becomes `absent` for the session. The bell's Activity feed then reads as unavailable without asking again.
- **Reach.** On the package-app path since objectui#12811. PR #13005 widens it to every console-created app (no `_packageId`).
- **Why it matters next.** objectui#12980 part 7 (the seat's ruling for `useNavMemberGates`: ask the union of every app's `requiresObject` names by name) would make the sidebar's capability gate read this path too. A transient error would then HIDE nav entries. The whole-registry path's error leaves the registered set empty and shows everything.

## Wanted
- The by-name scope read tells a not-found answer from a failed read.
- Only a not-found answer is recorded as `missing`.
- A failed read leaves the name unanswered (so `presence` reads `unknown` and a gate does not close), and it is asked again on a later read.
- ⛔ No change to what a not-found or found answer records.

## Done when
A test: a by-name read that rejects (5xx) leaves the name out of `missing` and `useObjectPresence` reads `unknown`; a 404 / not-found answer still records `missing` and reads `absent` (CONTROL).

## Dedupe
Searched for: `fetchScopeName`, `fetchScopeName error missing`, `useObjectPresence absent error`, `by-name object read failure`.
